teaser: What happens when a hunch arrives whole, before you can explain it, and you refuse to speak it until you can? That is the crossing of life path 11 and INTJ. The 11 carries a current of insight that moves faster than reasoning; the INTJ mind insists on reasoning before anything is said aloud. Here the two do not cancel each other so much as negotiate, daily, over what counts as knowing. The answer arrives before the argument for it does, and the wait, sometimes for weeks, is the particular weather of this crossing, not a flaw in either side.
excerpt: The smell of vending-machine coffee and antiseptic, hours into a hospital waiting room, and a partner notices you have already worked out what the doctor will say before anyone has said it.
